name: Tubbs Fire
note: Started around 9:43 pm on Sunday 8 Oct 2017 near Tubbs Lane, Calistoga; by 1 am on Monday 9 Oct it had reached the Santa Rosa city limits, and Fountaingrove, Coffey Park (about 1,300 structures), Larkfield-Wikiup and Mark West burned in the early hours.

name: Nuns Fire
note: One of the fires that broke out overnight on 8-9 Oct 2017, east and north of the city of Sonoma; it merged with the Norrbom (11 Oct), Adobe (12 Oct) and Oakmont (18 Oct) fires. Structures (Glen Ellen, Kenwood, Bennett Valley) are dated to the first night - ASSUMED, the fire burned homes over several days.

name: Atlas Fire
note: Started on 8 Oct 2017 north of Napa near Napa Soda Springs; 51,624 acres, 783 structures. Structures are dated to the first night (9 Oct) - ASSUMED.

name: Kincade Fire
note: Started 9:24 pm on 23 Oct 2019 at The Geysers and burned until 6 Nov. Structures are dated 27 Oct, the wind-driven run toward Healdsburg and Windsor - ESTIMATED (the alarm date would be 23 Oct).

name: LNU Lightning Complex (Hennessey Fire)
note: Lightning fires from 17 Aug 2020 merged into the Hennessey Fire in the hills around Napa, Fairfield and Vacaville. Structures are dated 19 Aug, the night run toward Vacaville and Lake Berryessa - ESTIMATED.

name: LNU Lightning Complex (Walbridge Fire)
note: Sonoma County part of the LNU Lightning Complex (from 17 Aug 2020), west of Healdsburg. Structures dated 19 Aug like the rest of the complex - ESTIMATED.

name: CZU Lightning Complex
note: First fires about 3:30 am on 16 Aug 2020 (lightning); two days later a change in the wind made the northern fires expand and merge. 1,490 buildings destroyed, in Boulder Creek, Bonny Doon, Swanton and nearby. Structures are dated to the night of 18-19 Aug.

name: Glass Fire
note: Started 3:48 am on 27 Sep 2020 near Glass Mountain Road, Deer Park; merged with two smaller fires and grew to 11,000 acres during the night of 27-28 Sep. Structures are dated 28 Sep.

name: Oakland Hills (Tunnel) Fire
note: The firestorm of the weekend of 19-20 Oct 1991 in the hills of north Oakland and south-east Berkeley: 1,520 acres, 25 dead, 2,843 single-family dwellings and 437 apartment and condominium units destroyed. Dated Sunday 20 Oct, the day of the firestorm (FRAP's alarm date reads 22 Oct).

name: Hanly Fire
note: Burned 52,700 acres (FRAP outline: 55,961 GIS acres) from Calistoga to Mendocino Avenue on the north edge of Santa Rosa, turning on its third day; only a few dozen homes burned, the country being sparsely settled in 1964. The Tubbs Fire followed its path in 2017. FRAP alarm date (19 Sep 1964) kept.

name: SCU Lightning Complex
note: Lightning fires in the Diablo Range (Santa Clara, Alameda, Contra Costa, San Joaquin, Merced and Stanislaus counties), 393,624 acres from 16 Aug to 1 Oct 2020. FRAP alarm date kept.

name: Lexington Fire
note: FRAP perimeter 'LEXINGTON' 1985: alarm date 7 Jul 1985, 13,128 GIS acres in the Santa Cruz Mountains above Lexington Reservoir. Alarm date kept; no structure data.

name: Mount Vision Fire
note: October 1995, started by an incompletely extinguished campfire on the Point Reyes peninsula: 12,354 acres and 45 homes in Inverness Park. FRAP alarm date (3 Oct 1995) kept.
